class.name: RailVehicleWipers
class.brief_description: Configures the windshield wiper programmer switch.
class.description: [RailVehicleWipers] wraps the FIZ [code]WiperList:[/code] section. [b]Not part of the simulation:[/b] the vehicle's simulation has no wiper state or configuration, so the wipers - the switch and the movement of every wiper - are simulated by this component itself.

method.name: get_sweep_positions
method.description: Where each wiper is: 0-1 sweeping out, 1-2 on the way back.

method.name: manual_fit
method.description: Wipers driven by hand, [param count] of them (at most [constant MANUAL_WIPERS_MAX]), by whoever builds the vehicle - one whose data gives its wipers no switch. A vehicle with a switch keeps its motor.

method.name: manual_get_position
method.description: Where the hand put [param wiper]'s handle, 0 parked - 1 across the sweep.

method.name: manual_set_all
method.description: The hand puts every wiper's handle at [param position] - the command [code]wipers_manual_set_all[/code].

method.name: manual_set_position
method.description: The hand puts [param wiper]'s handle at [param position], 0 parked - 1 across the sweep - the command [code]wipers_manual_set_<wiper>[/code]. Nothing while the wipers have a motor.

method.name: switch_decrease
method.description: The wiper switch one position back ([code]TTrain::OnCommand_wiperswitchdecrease[/code], [code]Train.cpp:2638-2661[/code]).

method.name: switch_increase
method.description: The wiper switch one position on ([code]TTrain::OnCommand_wiperswitchincrease[/code], [code]Train.cpp:2638-2661[/code]).

members.member: What moves the wipers: their motor, by the switch, or the driver's hand.
How many wipers the vehicle has; 0 counts them from the masks of the wiper list.

constants.constant: The wipers' motor moves them, by the switch.
The driver's hand moves each wiper by its handle.
The most wipers driven by hand, each with a command of its own.
